{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify QA orders: revenue_clean == 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]

# Filter for completed and converted orders
completed_and_converted = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['converted'] == 1)]

# Remove QA orders from the dataset
df_clean = completed_and_converted[~completed_and_converted.index.isin(qa_orders.index)]

# Compute average revenue per converted order by channel, within each customer_segment
avg_revenue_by_group = df_clean.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue_clean'].mean().reset_index()

# Pivot to compare email vs paid_search within each segment
pivot = avg_revenue_by_group.pivot(index='customer_segment', columns='channel', values='revenue_clean')

# Compute differences (email - paid_search) within each segment
pivot['difference'] = pivot['email'] - pivot['paid_search']

# Print the difference values for each segment
print("Difference in average revenue (email - paid_search) by segment:")
print(pivot['difference'])

# Also print the raw averages for each channel, within segments, for evidence
print("\nAverage revenue per converted order by channel and customer_segment:")
print(pivot)"}
